title: AP decisions & schemes: Jun-Aug 2026
quote: APCNF wins the 2026 Food Planet Prize ($1.5 million): AP CM called it a first for India

boxes.title: Talliki Vandanam 2026
items: DBT began **22 July 2026**: **₹13,000** credited to mothers
Sanctioned **₹10,120.78 crore**; **67,47,190** students
==**Every eligible child**== in a family, not one per family
Income: rural < **₹10,000**, urban < **₹12,000**/month; **Rice Card** mandatory
Excluded: **ITI** and **Polytechnic** students
Aim: lower dropout + higher **GER**

boxes.title: Local bodies & governance
items: ==**33.33%** BC reservation== in ULB polls; AP has **123** ULBs
Basis: **74th Amendment 1992**, Part IX-A; **Art 243T** leaves BC quota to States
**VB-G RAM G** replaced **MGNREGS** from **1 July 2026**: AP 1st (**2.10 crore** person-days)
**Lokayukta**: **Justice T. Mallikarjuna Rao** (Aug 2026, **5** years)
**Shakti**: Gram Sabhas under **PESA Act 1996**; **50%** women in committees

boxes.title: APCNF: Food Planet Prize
items: **2026 Food Planet Prize**, ==**$1.5 million**==; **Curt Bergfors Foundation**, Sweden (since **2019**)
Presented at **Båstad**, **2 June 2026**; **4** finalists from **1,000+** nominations
Launched **2016** by **Rythu Sadhikara Samstha** (RySS); input **Jeevamrutham**
~**1.8 million** families; **10,000+** resource persons (**60%** women)
Target: **100%** natural farming State by **2047**

boxes.title: Swarna Andhra @2047
items: Presented at **NITI Aayog Governing Council** (**11 Jun 2026**)
**Padi Sutralu**: ==**10** guiding principles== (Zero Poverty ... Deep Tech)
**P4**: **top 10%** support **bottom 20%**
AP TFR **below 1.5** → Population Management Policy
**IFMR** (Krea University) MoU: mission cells; target **15%** growth

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Netanna Sevalo launch: **Chirala** (⚠ CA-360: Kothapeta, Vetapalem); spelt **Nethannala Sevalo**
Talliki Vandanam = ==conditional cash transfer== for **GER** (G2-GS 2025 key)
PM SHRI: AP **1st** in fund use; model **government** schools (⚠ not private)
Robotic dog at **Alipiri-Tirumala** path will ==supplement==, not replace patrols
APCNF replicated in **22** States (⚠ CA-360: over **20**)
